_doc: BANG GIA VON — mot cho duy nhat cho toan bo ma nguon. Doc bang platform_core/gia_von.py.
DON VI: milli-credit (mcredit) = 1/1000 credit = 0,1 dong. TOAN BO LA SO NGUYEN.
Ly do o platform_core/llm/gia_token.py: dau phay dong trong duong tien la cach
chac chan nhat de hai lan cong ra hai ket qua.
TEN TRUONG lay dung theo LiteLLM model_prices_and_context_window.json (MIT) —
de ngay nao muon nap thang bang cua ho cho model moi thi khong phai viet lop dich.
Khac ho o hau to _mcredit (ho dung USD float) va o don vi token: mcredit cho 1 TRIEU
token, vi mcredit cho MOT token se nho hon 1 va khong con la so nguyen.
DAY LA GIA VON — thu TA TRA cho nha cung cap. KHONG phai gia ban.
Gia ban nam o credit_cost cua tung app. Hai so do khac nhau va phai khac nhau.
CHUA_TRA la MIEN TRU CO HAN, khong phai cho de quen. Moi muc phai co ly_do + chu + han_ra_lai; qua han la test do. Mot mien tru khong het han chinh la cach ma CREDIT_PER_IMAGE = 5 song duoc 22 ngay.
